stories.story_title: Alaska DEC seeks AI-assisted drones for continuing Halong recovery
stories.summary_2_sentences: DEC SPAR issued RFQ 18-904-27 on September 9, 2026 to procure U.S.-made drones supporting ongoing ex-Typhoon Halong response. The notice estimates $70,000-$80,000, with quotes above $90,000 potentially nonresponsive, and quotes due September 30 at 1 p.m. AKDT.

sources.fetch_note: Initial web open succeeded (138 lines) and search provides full notice; subsequent opens fail timeout and urllib returns server rejection HTML.

Search indexed PDF, but all direct fetch attempts failed; no real PDF saved. Search snippet says Skydio X10 Ready Kit (2.4/5GHz, 5G/LTE Ready, IR) NA + VT300-L. Header has apparent typo September 9, 2027; body September30 2026. Needs successful primary fetch.

facts: Notice issue September9 2026, quotes September30 1 p.m. AKDT, expected award and contract week October12
Four each X10 kits/services/data suites corroborated by HigherGov and GovTribe but primary PDF count still needs fetched confirmation

Manufacturer describes onboard Jetson Orin processing six navigation-camera views for real-time obstacle avoidance, assisted flight, automatic inspection/map capture. Do not imply oil detection or cleanup by AI.

Historical DEC February11 recovery plan describes fall2025 fuel spills, unknown volumes, frozen ground limiting soil assessment, and need for physical backhaul/remediation and indoor air tests. These are historical context, not verified September conditions.
stories.human_story_fuel: Winter can hide contamination: in Kongiganak DEC documented an inconclusive surface survey due to frozen ground; in Napaskiak fresh snow limited a spill assessment. A drone can extend sight, but imagery does not establish safe soil or safe indoor air.

quote.text: surface survey was inconclusive due to frozen ground conditions
quote.attribution: DEC February11 2026 recovery plan, Kongiganak assessment

stories.local_sentiment: No directly reported community reaction to this specific procurement found. DEC describes coordinated recovery with communities and Tribal organizations; do not invent local approval or concern.
caveats: Purchase solicitation, not award, delivery or field deployment
HigherGov has incorrect Oct15 deadline and AI-estimate budget; do not use those
Do not imply drone has sampled soil, detected fuel autonomously or approved reoccupation
Historical recovery figures must remain dated
